title: Business Development Representative Latam
description:
Você é uma pessoa curiosa, analítica e que adora conversar com quem decide? Gosta de estudar mercado, entender dores e abrir portas com inteligência e estratégia?


Na Accountfy, procuramos um(a) BDR com cabeça de negócio, interesse genuíno por finanças e interesse por construir relações comerciais que geram valor de verdade.


Aqui, a prospecção é consultiva, e o seu papel vai muito além de marcar reuniões: você vai ser a primeira ponte entre a dor do cliente e a solução que transforma a gestão financeira de empresas com tecnologia.


O que esperamos de você

- Capacidade de entender contextos de negócio e dores financeiras com profundidade.

- Raciocínio lógico afiado para interpretar dados e gerar abordagens personalizadas.

- Clareza e objetividade para escrever e-mails, mensagens e scripts impactantes.

- Persistência com inteligência: você sabe quando insistir e quando recuar.

- Capacidade de qualificar leads com critério, usando metodologias (SPIN, MEDDIC, etc.).

- Vontade real de aprender sobre finanças corporativas e SaaS B2B.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills):

- Experiência anterior como SDR, BDR ou pré-vendas em contexto B2B.

- Familiaridade com vendas consultivas (não precisa ser expert, mas saber jogar no campo).

- Conhecimento básico de finanças corporativas (DRE, EBITDA, planejamento orçamentário).

- CRM (Hubspot, Pipedrive ou Salesforce).

- Espanhol Fluente (será testado na entrevista)


Soft Skills que fazem a diferença:

- Escuta ativa + comunicação afiada

- Proatividade com estratégia

- Aprendizado rápido

- Interesse genuíno pelo mundo financeiro, empresarial e de tecnologia

- Colaboração com outras áreas (vendas, marketing, produto)

title: Senior AEM Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior AEM Developer


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Java com experiência comprovada em liderança de times técnicos. Procuramos alguém com sólida bagagem em desenvolvimento backend, que conheça os desafios de ambientes de alta performance e que tenha atuado como referência técnica e gestora de equipe.

O(a) profissional ideal sabe equilibrar o desenvolvimento de código com a gestão do time, promovendo boas práticas, apoiando o time e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e performance das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time na tomada de decisões técnicas e resolução de problemas.
  • Realizar code reviews e propor melhorias técnicas contínuas.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções (mão na massa).
  • Conduzir ritos ágeis e colaborar com áreas parceiras.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o desempenho do time (1:1, feedbacks, planos de desenvolvimento).
  • Estimular boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Acompanhar prazos de entrega de melhorias e correções de bugs, garantindo previsibilidade e alinhamento.
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor soluções com uso de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, ganho de produtividade e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead Java.
  • Sólida experiência com Java 8 ou superior (utilizamos Java 21), além de Spring Boot e Spring MVC.
  • Experiência com Hibernate, JUnit 5, Mockito 2 e Git.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  • Experiência com Redis.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.
  • Familiaridade com VueJS, TypeScript e Javascript.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta concorrência, performance e grandes volumes de dados.
  • Habilidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.



Desejáveis:


  • Experiência com análise de logs e troubleshooting.
  • Otimização de queries e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento em Kibana/APM.
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e PL/SQL.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Ionic + VueJS).
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas: JSP, AngularJS, jQuery.


Ambiente técnico:


  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker.
  • Repositórios no GitHub.
  • IntelliJ Ultimate como IDE.

title: German-Speaking Freelance Customer Support – E-Bike Specialist (Remote Worldwide)
description:
Workster is partnering with a rapidly growing European e-mobility company that makes high-quality e-bikes accessible across the DACH region. To support their expanding customer base, we are looking for a German-speaking Freelance Customer Support Specialist who can work remotely from anywhere in the World.


This role is ideal for independent professionals who are passionate about customer experience, sustainability, and modern mobility solutions. As a key point of contact, you will support users throughout their entire journey — from choosing the right e-bike to ensuring a smooth after-sales experience.


Your Role

  • Respond to customer inquiries via email, chat, and occasional phone calls.
  • Assist customers in selecting the right e-bike based on needs, preferences, and budget.
  • Provide accurate product details and personalised recommendations.
  • Give updates on deliveries and handle after-sales issues (warranty, missing parts, adjustments).
  • Escalate and resolve complex cases in coordination with internal departments.
  • Suggest improvements to processes, FAQs, and customer success tools.
  • Maintain high-quality communication and efficient handling of all requests.


Your Qualifications

  • Ability to invoice as a registered freelancer or company (B2B setup required).
  • Native or fluent German + strong B2 English.
  • Previous customer support or client-facing experience.
  • Independent, well-organised, and proactive problem solver.
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing your own schedule.
  • Positive, customer-focused mindset with strong communication skills.
  • Interest in tech and e-mobility is an advantage.
  • Flexible availability within 12:00–00:00 CET (shifts to be defined).


The Offer

  • Fully remote work from anywhere within Europe.
  • Flexible working hours with autonomy over your schedule.
  • Work with a multicultural, mission-driven, and innovative team.
  • Training and ongoing product support provided.
  • Competitive freelance compensation: 13.5–15.5 € per hour , with the first 2 weeks at 50% for onboarding.
  • Start date: 5th January or 2nd February.
  • Shift details and final working hours: TBD .


Benefits

  • Competitive base rate
  • Remote work across the World.
  • Supportive multicultural team
  • Dynamic and sustainable industry


Recruitment process:

  • Phone interview with Workster recruiter
  • Online language test (German + English if needed)
  • HR interview
  • Final interview with the Hiring Manager


Apply now!

title: Analista de Suporte Especializado Pleno \"#988869\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Monitoração batch nas ferramentas/aplicações utilizadas pela companhia, sistemas e de todos os itens de configuração os quais estão cadastrados junto às ferramentas batch disponíveis para o time de Scheduling;
  • Prover um monitoramento rápido e assertivo com o mínimo de impacto ao ambiente e em caso de ALERTA-INCIDENTE, acionar as áreas especialistas através de contato telefônico ou outro meio de comunicação disponível, formalizando o acionamento via E-mail;
  • Registro dos incidentes nas ferramentas de controle, prover a comunicação dos mesmos via WhatsApp e quando necessário acionar a Gestão de TI para posicionamento;
  • Prover escalation em caso de impossibilidade de contato com o especialista responsável pelo suporte ao ALERTA-INCIDENTE gerado;
  • Documentar todos os processos realizados pela equipe de Scheduling, utilizando as ferramentas disponíveis para documentação, deixando-os disponíveis em ambiente de acesso para a equipe de Scheduling visando a agilidade dos processos, a fácil resolução de problemas conhecidos e para futuras consultas e processos;
  • Realizar atendimento de Requisições e Incidentes de N1 e interagir com as demais áreas da TI;
  • Estar atento as oportunidades de melhorias junto aos processos da área e quando possível apoiar na solução;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas e diretrizes de segurança da informação e a aderência das atividades às mesmas.

O que você precisa ter

  • Boa comunicação, proativo, gostar de tecnologia e buscar conhecimento;
  • Senso de urgência, foco, atenção e priorização dos acionamentos críticos para o negócio e que causam impacto financeiro;
  • Estar cursando uma faculdade voltada para área de TI ou afins;
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas Linux e Windows;
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas de monitoração Zabbix, Grafana, Pager Duty e IBM Control Center;
  • Conhecimentos em Shell script, Ansible e Phyton será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos em Control-M – BMC Software; IBM Connect Direct e IBM Sterling B2B;
  • Conhecimentos de JOBS para análise e Schedulagem no Control-M;
  • Disponibilidade de horário para trabalho em regime de escala 24X7;
  • Conhecimento na ferramenta Control-M, IBM Sterling B2B e IBM Connect Direct .

description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

Como Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução da plataforma do cliente dentro de uma squad multidisciplinar.

O papel envolve não apenas o desenvolvimento de novas features e produtos, mas também a definição de soluções técnicas estratégicas, garantindo que o software seja robusto, escalável, seguro, performático e de alta qualidade. * Suportar o time em desafios técnicos complexos, fomentando inovação e melhoria contínua.

* Conduzir code reviews, mentorias e compartilhamento de conhecimento para desenvolvimento técnico da equipe.

Requisitos:

* Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software em arquitetura Cloud Native.

* Experiência com Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

* Domínio das linguagens Kotlin (principal) e Java.

title: Senior AEM Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior AEM Developer


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conectar-se com clientes da nossa base de dados e novos leads, apresentando e vendendo mais de 30 produtos exclusivos da RPN, referência no mercado de nutracêuticos de alta conversão.
  • Atender com excelência e agilidade em diversos canais de comunicação: e-mail, formulários, WhatsApp, telefone , entre outros.
  • Atuar como um consultor de vendas, garantindo uma experiência única e fidelizando clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas – Você domina a arte de encantar clientes e fechar negócios com confiança.
  • Foco em metas e resultados – Amamos pessoas que gostam de superar desafios.
  • Habilidade em atendimento – Saber ouvir e entender as necessidades do cliente é essencial para oferecer as soluções ideais.

  • Um computador ou notebook com capacidade para rodar nosso sistema de vendas e CRM.
  • Conexão de internet com no mínimo 100 Mbps .
  • Precisa ter condições de substituiçao do mesmo de foma fácil em caso de manutenção.
  • Um espaço silencioso e organizado em sua casa, ideal para atender clientes com profissionalismo e foco.


Modelo de Contratação:

  • Contrato via CLT ou PJ, com jornada de trabalho em horário fixo. O cumprimento da escala será obrigatório.
  • Após envio do currículo, os selecionados passarão por análise e entrevista com os diretores da empresa.


O que oferecemos:

  • Salário fixo de R$ 1.760,00 . (+ reajuste anual)

  • As compras de nossos produtos poderão ser efetuadas e abatidas em salário.
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed**

title: Clojure Engineer
description:
About the Company

A well-funded, mission-driven fintech company is expanding its remote-first engineering team. Their goal is to scale a digital lending platform that helps borrowers reduce debt — having already refinanced over $6B in loans. They’re hiring senior engineers passionate about building scalable, reliable systems using Clojure .


Key Details

  • Role: Software Engineer (Clojure) – LATAM
  • Type: Contractor (12-month project, full-time)
  • Location: 100% Remote – Open to LATAM candidates only
  • Tech Stack: Clojure (primary), ClojureScript or other front-end techs (React, JS frameworks), Clojure REPL, Idiomatic Clojure
  • Team Culture: Collaborative, low-ego, values ownership, honesty, and functional programming
  • Start Date: Immediate (flexible onboarding available)


What They’ll Do


Build and maintain clean, well-tested APIs in Clojure.

Contribute to scalable, production-grade systems in a lending platform.

Participate actively in a fully remote, collaborative environment.

Take ownership of their work and mentor others when possible.

Provide direct, constructive feedback on PRs.

Leverage AI tools to increase productivity.


What We’re Looking For


At least 5 years of total software engineering experience (does not need to be 5 years of Clojure experience)

Practical, hands-on Clojure experience (not just coursework; building in production environments)

Strong grasp of functional programming concepts (Elixir, Scala, Haskell, or Lisp experience can be relevant if combined with applied Clojure exposure)

English proficiency (can understand with ease virtually everything heard or read)

Comfort with start-up pace and culture; high sense of ownership and accountability

Open communicator who values feedback and collaborative problem-solving

A genuine interest in working for a mission-driven company helping reduce financial burdens for everyday people

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Angular Developer
description:
Job Title: Angular Developer

Location: Brazil /Remote

Experience: 5 – 8 Years

Primary Skill: Angular

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Angular Developer with strong hands-on experience in building scalable, enterprise-level web applications. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in modern Angular frameworks and front-end architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop large-scale intranet and internet applications using Angular 14+ .
  • Build reusable, modular UI components and create shared library packages .
  • Implement Micro Frontend architecture and follow best design practices.
  • Translate Figma UX designs into responsive Angular components.
  • Integrate backend APIs and handle data using reactive programming (RxJS ).
  • Ensure application quality through unit testing and code reviews.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Participate in system analysis, design, architecture, and SDLC activities.
  • Contribute as an SME in at least one application development area.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Angular (8+) , preferably Angular 14+
  • Expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • Experience with PrimeNG 14+
  • Strong knowledge of RxJS and reactive programming
  • Experience with Micro Frontends
  • Working knowledge of Jasmine & Karma
  • Experience with Git , JIRA
  • Solid understanding of Angular architecture and design patterns
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Good to Have

  • Experience with Node.js, Jenkins, OpenShift, Autosys
  • Exposure to MongoDB / Oracle
  • CI/CD pipeline experience using Jenkins

description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub!

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, permitindo-nos operar em uma variedade de modelos e formatos de equipe para proporcionar oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento. Você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e operar aplicações baseadas em IA, integrar modelos e agentes a sistemas existentes, e colaborar com times de produto e engenharia para transformar casos de uso em soluções reais em produção. O papel envolve desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes e otimização contínua das soluções.

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;

  • Forte conhecimento em GCP (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, APIs, serviços gerenciados, etc.);
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis e orientadas a eventos;
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e colaboração em equipe


Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps;

  • Conhecimento em MLOps e pipelines de deploy de modelos
  • Experiência com Python, frameworks de IA e bibliotecas modernas
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud-native e microsserviços
  • Experiência prévia com clientes internacionais


Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

  • Solid understanding of Angular architecture and design patterns
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Good to Have

  • Experience with Node.js, Jenkins, OpenShift, Autosys
  • Exposure to MongoDB / Oracle
  • CI/CD pipeline experience using Jenkins

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!


⚡ Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil


Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui


Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo


Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:


  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:


️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Somos uma escola de idiomas online que oferece aulas particulares ao vivo, sob demanda, com foco em conversação e situações reais do dia a dia. Nosso método é comunicativo e baseado em lexical chunks, expressões úteis e naturais do idioma, para ajudar nossos alunos a se comunicarem com confiança desde as primeiras aulas.


Nossa escola está iniciando uma nova fase e abrindo vagas para professores de inglês online que queiram fazer parte de algo diferente. As aulas começam oficialmente no dia 5 de janeiro de 2026 , e este será o início de um projeto que une tecnologia, flexibilidade e um método de ensino moderno focado na comunicação real. Se você acredita que ensinar inglês vai muito além da gramática, e quer participar de um projeto em crescimento, esta oportunidade é para você.


Carga horária de 8 horas de diárias, segunda a sexta com horários pela manhã ou pela noite.


Responsabilidades

Dar aulas particulares online (1:1) a alunos de diferentes níveis.

Seguir o plano de aula e o método comunicativo da escola.

Ajudar o aluno a praticar vocabulário e expressões do cotidiano.

Corrigir a pronúncia, gramática e fluência de forma natural durante a conversa.

Escrever um breve feedback após cada aula.

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

description:

Darkex aims to be leading cryptocurrency service platform headquartered in Dubai, with additional entities in Panama, Cayman, and Georgia. As a pioneer in the rapidly evolving digital asset industry, Darkex provides a comprehensive range of services including trading, asset management etc. to clients worldwide.


With a commitment to compliance, security, and innovation, Darkex is dedicated to providing reliable and transparent services that meet the needs of both individual and institutional investors in the digital economy.


Description:

Darkex is becoming one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in Europe, serving a rapidly growing base of corporate customers. To support this growth, we are looking for long-term Business Development Partners who can help us expand our global reach through strong networks and local market access.



We are a good match if you:


  • Have an existing network in crypto, Web3, fintech, or trading
  • Can bring corporate clients, partners, communities, and KOL connections
  • Are strong at opening doors and closing partnerships
  • Understand local markets and how crypto users behave
  • Want to build a long-term partnership with an exchange, not a one-off deal

  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or B2B sales (crypto or fintech)
  • A clear portfolio (partners, communities, institutions, or clients you work with)
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of KYC / KYB and AML
  • Comfort in a client-facing role
  • Interest in crypto, trading, and blockchain

  • Introduce and onboard new KOLs, business partners and corporate clients

  • Negotiate commercial terms
  • Work with internal teams on onboarding and growth
  • Support volume and revenue growth through partnerships
  • Report progress and achieve KPIs


What matters most:


  • Your network
  • Your portfolio
  • Your market access
  • Your interest in long-term collaboration

title: English Teacher
description:
Company Overview:


AM Consultoria de Inglês is dedicated to transforming our students' lives through exceptional English language services. We offer more than just English classes; our comprehensive approach includes personalised meetings and continuous follow-ups to ensure student success. Our team is innovative, passionate, and committed to overcoming obstacles for the sake of student development. If you are driven to make a significant impact on your students' lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team. However, if you are merely seeking a teaching position, AM Consultoria de Inglês may not be the right fit for you. We pride ourselves on honesty and transparency from the selection process through to our daily operations. Join us and achieve above-average results together!


Job Characteristics:

Position: ESL Teacher

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Start Date: January 2026

Note: Candidates MUST be available to work Monday through Thursday, 7-9pm.


Responsibilities:

- Plan and deliver engaging, memorable classes.

- Respond to student inquiries via WhatsApp outside of class hours.

- Correct homework and activities on teaching platform.

- Periodically contact students to understand and meet their needs.

- Focus on student results beyond class hours.

- Offer comprehensive support to students in a compassionate manner.

- Pursue continuous professional development.

- Have good quality video and audio. 

- Have a high speed and reliable internet connection. 

- Participate in weekly team meetings (Monday’s at 10am, for 30 minutes)


Qualification:

CELTA, DELTA or TKT certification from Cambridge. 


What we are looking for:

- C2 English proficiency level

- Ability to teach using the communicative approach

- Teachers who bring positve energy to class 

- Strong ability to use online teaching platforms and digital tools effectively

- Ambition and a desire for growth, with the potential to become a leader.

- Humility and a willingness to learn and adapt.

- A positive attitude towards feedback, recognising its importance in improving client impact.

- Willingness to embrace responsibilities and challenges.

- Excellent communication skills to initiate and engage in conversations aimed at service improvement.

- Applicants with significant experience living, working, or studying in an English-speaking environment will be highly considered.


Why join us: 


- Join a growing company with great growth opportunities.

- Enjoy above-average remuneration compared to other ESL schools in Brazil.

- Work with motivated adult learners aiming for better job opportunities.

- Experience a unique teaching methodology distinct from market offerings.

- Contribute to and influence product development and improvements.

- Access professional development opportunities through the company.


We look forward to welcoming passionate and committed professionals to our team. Apply now and be part of a company that truly values and invests in both its students and its team.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Client's growing team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in web development with expertise in React , JavaScript, and Python . They must be comfortable working independently and will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining a high-performance web application.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a robust, scalable web application, handling both front-end (JavaScript, React) and back-end (Python) responsibilities.
  • Take leadership of architecture and design efforts for new features within the application, ensuring alignment with best practices and company standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to help design, iterate, & develop new features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Maintain and optimize existing codebase to maximize stability, performance and scalability.
  • Work with Python to develop backend services and APIs, and with JavaScript and React to enhance front-end processes and functionality.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, providing technical leadership and helping them grow their skills.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and consistency across the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend improvements to the technology stack.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack of the application.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience , with a strong focus on web development with Python .
  • Proficiency in React , JavaScript (ES5+), and modern web development practices.
  • Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically about issues.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proven experience leading projects and mentoring junior developers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Python experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with databases such as MongoDB.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design.
  • Understanding of security best practices in web development.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with JavaScript development tools such as Storybook and Playwright.
  • Experience with API integrations with platforms like Workday or similar.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

Hit weekly and monthly meeting quotas consistently



What We're Looking For


Minimum 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting experience in B2B

Proven track record of hitting quota—bring your numbers

Comfortable with rejection and high-volume activity

Clear, professional phone presence

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional setup

Coachable with a no-excuses attitude toward performance



Bonus Points


Experience in lead gen agencies or sales development roles

Familiarity with dialers, CRMs, and outbound tech stacks

Background calling into professional services, manufacturing, or mid-market B2B



Compensation

Base + performance bonuses tied to meetings booked. Top performers earn significantly more. Details discussed during interviews.


How to Apply

  • Follow our Linkedin Company Page and our Founder Enzo Carasso before applying so we can see that actually read the entire Job Description.
  • Once you've completed the above - send a connection request to Enzo Carasso with a short note on why you're a fit. Include your last 3 months of performance metrics if available-conversion rates, dials per day, meetings booked. No fluff, just results.

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.
